description: Blocks requests to specified URL patterns — useful for simulating third-party outages (analytics, CDNs, tracking). Use to answer: does the app still load and function if Google Analytics or a CDN is down?

block_patterns.description: Glob patterns for requests to block (e.g., ['**/analytics**', '*.doubleclick.net/**'])

core_content_selector.description: CSS selector for core content that must still be present (e.g., '.main-content')

url.description: URL of the page to test

wait_ms.description: Milliseconds to wait after navigation before checking core content (default: 2000)

name: block_resources
